summary: Senior Manager, Treasury Analytics candidate with ~7 years in Asset-Liability Management (ALM), cash-flow modelling, and quantitative interest-rate risk modelling across institutional treasury and balance-sheet mandates. Holds delegated sign-off authority at Moody's Analytics on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement, and led design of a multi-scenario cash-flow projection engine embedding behavioural and prepayment assumptions. Reviews interest-rate derivatives valuation, yield-curve construction, and spread calibration, with hands-on stochastic/Monte Carlo and VaR/CVaR modelling from ALM advisory work. Python and SQL practitioner; CFA and dual MSc.
core_skills: Interest Rate Risk Modelling, Duration & Key-Rate Analytics
Interest Rate Derivatives Valuation (Rates, FX, Inflation)
Python, SQL, R, MATLAB, Advanced Excel
Executive Reporting on Risk Drivers & Sensitivities

roles.title: Asst. Director - Modelling Services (Investment & ALM Risk Lead)

sections.heading: Cash-Flow Modelling & Behavioural Risk Analytics
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios, delivering forward-looking liquidity visibility across ALM horizons.

Embedded behavioural cash-flow assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays into projection models, aligning outputs with regulatory liquidity expectations and executive contingency planning.
Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year) enabling funding optimization, refinancing-risk assessment, and asset-allocation decisions.

sections.heading: Interest Rate & Derivatives Valuation Analytics
bullets: Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing yield curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions before production release.
Validated derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, confirming sensitivity consistency at portfolio-level ALM aggregates.
Oversaw Interest Rate Risk and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate-shock scenarios, consistent with industry IRRBB methodology.

Prepared analytical summaries for senior stakeholders explaining interest-rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities, translating quantitative output into decision-ready narratives on risk drivers.

sections.heading: Model Governance, Review & Production Support
bullets: Serves on the model governance committee, contributing to methodology review, benchmarking, documentation standards, and model-performance assessment for client-delivered analytics.
Reviewed aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics feeding downstream ALM processes; escalated outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility.

Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and auditability controls, delivered on PFaroe DB (risk & ALM) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management).

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms on the PFaroe platform; advised on asset, liability, and ALM configuration and validated model outputs post-deployment.
Translated client investment-team requirements into scoped development requests for Product Owners and migrated all assigned accounts from a legacy Calypso environment.

roles.title: Senior Consultant - IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.
Advised actuarial, finance, IT, and program-management functions on standard adoption; contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing Interest Rate Risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.
Performed cash-flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk for international institutional clients.

Delivered ALM studies analyzing funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet risk exposures; modelled actuarial liabilities alongside all major investment-product types and economic variables.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition and attribution to test allocation robustness, and presented findings to pension investment committees.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
